Excuse the scratchiness of my voice! I'm still trying to figure out different ways to mix and I kind of recorded this in one sitting and didn't feel like redoing anything. 8D

I never watched Re:Zero and I probably never will! :D I just really like this song and Rie Takahashi's voice. //cries

ENJOY,  STAY ALIVE AND THANKS FOR LISTENING
-BriCie
